note: Event ids are shared by the code that fires the sound, the asset that answers it, and the checks that verify both. Call PgAudio.Fire("id") where the sound plays, or PgAudio.Watch() to infer ids from AudioSource activity without touching the game.

footstep.note: A footstep firing more than a few times a second is the classic per-frame bug. It is also the single most common thing players describe as 'the audio feels wrong'.

weapon.fire.note: Leading silence on a weapon is heard as input lag, not as audio.

music.ambient.note: mustLoop compares the first and last samples and fails on a seam that would click.
